notes: «وَ غَيْرِهِ» means «and others»: an unnamed co-transmitter on the level of أبان
«عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ» sits inside the chain after «عن»: narrator
«قَضَى أَمِيرُ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ» is quoted by the Imam, who is a link before it, so no ruling is needed; the chain does not go on to Ali
